title: START AT with a value that is not in the result starts at the first row after it
query: EVALUATE VALUES ( Product[Product] ) ORDER BY Product[Product] START AT "Hat"

source.quote: It defines the value at which the query results begin.
source.supports: the result begins at the value

source.quote: Rows before this sales order are not included in the result table.
source.supports: the rows that sort before the value are left out

derivation: Sorted: Bike, Helmet, Lock, Scooter. "Hat" sorts after "Bike" and before "Helmet" (a before e), so Bike is before the starting value and is left out.
